description: Header file defining guards and related classes/functions for Torch Dynamo, including guard management, local state, and tensor checking.

classes.name: LocalState
classes.description: Holds thread-local state related to dispatch keys, grad mode, and Python key masking.

classes.name: TensorCheck
classes.description: Class for checking tensor properties and validity based on local state and dispatch keys.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the current local state's dispatch key modifications to a given dispatch key set.

methods.name: overrideDispatchKeySet
methods.description: Overrides the dispatch key set in local state.

methods.name: TensorCheck (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a TensorCheck object with tensor properties and dispatch info.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a tensor satisfies the specified properties.

methods.name: check_verbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose string describing tensor check results.
